blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–For years, the Philippine men’s volleyball team has battled a persistent lack of support. Despite the sport’s growing popularity in the country, Alas Pilipinas players say they continue to deal with inadequate allowances, highlighting the challenges they face while representing the Philippines at the Asian Games. After their stand against powerhouse South Korea, Bryan Bagunas, the face and voice of Philippine men’s volleyball, expressed his frustration over the squad’s lack of resources. “Of course, the support is important.
